news.title: SOBHA: Dividend Prospects And Revised Assumptions May Support Future Upside Potential
news.body: Analysts now see Sobha's fair value at ₹2,180.68, mildly lower than the prior ₹2,263.16, reflecting updated assumptions for revenue growth, profit margins, and future P/E expectations. What's in the News Sobha plans to seek shareholder approval at its 31st AGM on July 18, 2026, for a recommended dividend of ₹6 per fully paid equity share of face value ₹10 for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, along with a pro rata dividend on partly paid shares.

news.title: Now 20% undervalued after recent price drop
news.body: Over the last 90 days, the stock has fallen 6.8% to ₹1,382. The fair value is estimated to be ₹1,731, however this is not to be taken as a buy recommendation but rather should be used as a guide only. Revenue has grown by 14% over the last 3 years. Earnings per share has grown by 15%. For the next 3 years, revenue is forecast to grow by 17% per annum. Earnings are also forecast to grow by 45% per annum over the same time period.

news.title: SOBHA: Fair View Will Be Reassessed As Dividend And Margins Are Refined
news.body: Analysts have lifted Sobha's fair value estimate from ₹1,325 to ₹1,450, citing updated assumptions on the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margins, and future P/E that feed through to their revised price target framework. What's in the News Sobha has scheduled its 31st AGM for July 18, 2026, where shareholders are set to consider a final dividend for the financial year ended March 31, 2026 (Key Developments).

news.title: Consensus EPS estimates fall by 12%, revenue upgraded
news.body: The consensus outlook for fiscal year 2027 has been updated. 2027 revenue forecast increased from ₹59.9b to ₹61.0b. EPS estimate fell from ₹51.51 to ₹45.41 per share. Net income forecast to grow 151% next year vs 45% growth forecast for Real Estate industry in India. Consensus price target broadly unchanged at ₹1,780. Share price fell 3.6% to ₹1,394 over the past week.

news.title: New minor risk - Dividend sustainability
news.body: The company has an unstable dividend paying track record. The dividend has had an annual drop of over 20% in the past. Dividend yield: 0.4% This is considered a minor risk. If the company has cut or reduced its dividend in the past, it may be a sign that the underlying business is too cyclical to consistently maintain or grow the dividend over the long-term. It may also indicate the company prioritizes other outcomes instead of maintaining the dividend. For dividend paying companies, any reduction in the dividend can significantly impact the share price. This is currently the only risk that has been identified for the company.

Valuation Changes Fair Value: Revised from ₹2,412.67 to ₹2,263.16, representing a modest reduction in the central estimate.

news.title: SOBHA: Fair View Will Be Tested By January Results Update
news.body: Analysts have trimmed Sobha's fair value estimate from ₹1,480 to ₹1,325, reflecting updated assumptions on discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E multiples in their price target work. What's in the News Sobha has scheduled a board meeting on January 16, 2026 to consider the unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter ended December 31, 2025.

news.title: SOBHA: Fair View Will Stay Intact Into January Results Review
news.body: Analysts have kept Sobha's fair value estimate steady at ₹1,480, pointing to only modest tweaks in their assumptions around discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E that do not materially affect the price target. What's in the News Sobha has scheduled a board meeting on Jan 16, 2026, to consider the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended Dec 31, 2025 (company filing).

news.title: SOBHA: Fair View Will Stay Intact Ahead Of Upcoming Results
news.body: Analysts have kept Sobha's price target unchanged at ₹1,480. The updated view reflects slightly adjusted inputs around discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E assumptions rather than a shift in overall conviction.

news.title: SOBHA: Fair View Will Hold Steady Ahead Of Quarterly Results
news.body: Analysts have nudged their fair value estimate for Sobha slightly higher from ₹1,475 to ₹1,480, reflecting updated assumptions for revenue growth, profit margins, discount rate, and future P/E that they see as better aligned with recent expectations. What's in the News Board meeting scheduled for January 16, 2026, to review and consider the unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter ended December 31, 2025 (Key Developments).

news.title: SOBHA: Future View Will Maintain Steady Outlook Ahead Of Upcoming Results
news.body: Analysts have maintained their fair value estimate for Sobha at ₹1,475.00, explaining that slightly revised assumptions for revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E now underpin the same headline target despite modest adjustments to the discount rate. What's in the News Sobha has scheduled a board meeting on January 16, 2026 to review the unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter ended December 31, 2025 (Key Developments).

news.title: Consensus EPS estimates fall by 19%
news.body: The consensus outlook for earnings per share (EPS) in fiscal year 2026 has deteriorated. 2026 revenue forecast decreased from ₹49.5b to ₹48.7b. EPS estimate also fell from ₹32.36 per share to ₹26.29 per share. Net income forecast to grow 231% next year vs 45% growth forecast for Real Estate industry in India. Consensus price target broadly unchanged at ₹1,831. Share price fell 9.5% to ₹1,382 over the past week.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues miss analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.44 (down from ₹2.15 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹9.83b (down 22% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹154.3m (down 29% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 1.6% (down from 1.7% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by lower revenue. Revenue missed analyst estimates by 32%. Earnings per share (EPS) also missed analyst estimates by 87%. Revenue is forecast to grow 21% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 24% growth forecast for the Real Estate industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 16% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 35% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.body: Analysts kept Sobha's fair value estimate steady at ₹1,475.00, with small tweaks to assumptions on the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin, and future P/E guiding the unchanged price target. What's in the News Sobha has scheduled a Board meeting on January 16, 2026, to consider the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended December 31, 2025 (Key Developments).
